procedure: Held-out sample (seed 'heldout-2026') of T4 verifier decisions from the four main models, excluding every case on the development sheet. For each case the auditor inspected the verifier's match, the citation's target and the top index candidates at any year (lenient score), and judged whether the verifier's label is correct. For NOT_FOUND the auditor also classified the cited case. Judgments were made against the index and the auditor's knowledge of Supreme Court case law; a party combination with no Supreme Court judgment in any year of the index is classed as 'fabricated'.

categories_not_found.fabricated: no Supreme Court judgment with these parties in any year of the index
categories_not_found.generic_no_match_near_year: party names so common that same-named judgments exist in other years, none near the stated year
categories_not_found.real_misdated_misnamed: a real judgment the model evidently meant, with wrong year and altered name
categories_not_found.not_a_judgment: the model cited something that is not a judgment
categories_not_found.verifier_miss: a real judgment within the year window that the verifier failed to match (verifier error)
